claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tolazoline is an adrenergic/imidazoline receptor antagonist with no DNA-damaging or broadly cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to produce little or no antiproliferative killing, with any weak effect reflecting adrenergic/imidazoline receptor antagonism rather than a cytotoxic class effect.
